title: Baseline OneAgent POC from tenant credentials to demo assets
description: Customer provides tenant URL, token, and success criteria. Agent should onboard the tenant, validate telemetry, deploy required config, and produce demo artifacts.

title: POC with application logs available only on custom file-system path
description: Customer telemetry relies on application logs written to a non-default location. Agent should account for collection strategy, validation, and correlation with the use case.

title: POC where OpenTelemetry is primary and OneAgent is not available
description: Customer emits logs, traces, and metrics via OpenTelemetry. Agent should shape the POC around OTel signals and avoid OneAgent-only assumptions.

title: POC with agentic workflow and notification automation
description: Agent should create automation or notification workflows in addition to dashboards and telemetry validation.

title: CLI-first POC execution with dtctl
description: Agent should use dtctl as the main operational path for tenant verification, DQL queries, and settings deployment instead of relying only on UI or MCP.

title: POC that depends on ingest-time parsing and enrichment
description: Agent should convert raw incoming records into normalized fields through OpenPipeline or deliberately fall back to query-time parsing when the ingest path does not support pipeline enrichment.
